dina: Heads up: saw a burst of duplicated trailing tokens after the routing change. Customers report repeated sentence endings when clients reconnect within ~300ms.
rene: Repro in staging: proxy accepted resume, client resumed, then runtime replayed last chunk because KV commit hadn't landed.
omar: Short log snippet:
[08:15:02] conn=p1 tenant=t-305 seq=210 active
[08:15:03] network close
[08:15:03] reconnect resume_token=rt-9 -> proxy: resume ok (lease=l-77)
[08:15:03] runtime: lease miss -> re-eval seq=210 -> emit seq=210 (dup)
tara: We need a safer resume contract. Idea: treat resume like a lease/commit pairing: proxy grants a short-lived "resume-lease" but runtime must atomically commit the session state and respond with a resume_ack before proxy marks session fully resumed. If ack delayed, proxy should hold client input and emit a control event telling SDK to queue/backoff.
dina: For protocols: SSE send in-stream event {"event":"resume","lease":"l-77","status":"lease-granted"} then later {"event":"resume","status":"committed","last_seq":211,"resume_ack":"ack-77"}. WS send JSON frames.
omar: Telemetry: add resume_lease_status (granted|committed|expired), lease_ttl_ms, resume_ack_latency_ms, dup_emitted boolean, charged_during_lease boolean. Console: surface per-tenant "optimistic-resume" ratio and a map of active lease states.
tara: Billing behavior: tokens emitted during 'lease-granted' should be tentatively unbilled; only mark as billable on commit. Implement a short compensation window to waive provisional tokens if commit fails.
sdk-team: SDK changes: on lease-granted, queue user writes for up to N ms, expose resume_state to app. Add opt-in to bypass queue for low-latency apps knowing risk of duplicates.
deploy-bot: Rollout: routing-v5 -> 30% (2026-03-14T08:10Z)
ops-bot: Alert: t-305 duplicate_token spike at 08:15 (5 events).
dina: Action items:
- omar: prototype lease + resume_ack handshake on proxy/runtime (PR)
- tara: spec control events and lease lifecycle + docs (PR)
- sdk-team: SDK queuing + opt-in bypass (PR)
- billing: provisional token waiver proposal (ticket)
- ops: dashboard panel for optimistic-resume ratio (PR)
Please paste PR/ticket links here. Quick sync at 09:00 to decide flagging strategy.
